pd_earnest_4.summary: Cecily and Gwendolen trade barbed politeness until servants arrive to restrain them.
Over tea, they exchange sweet insults about town and country.
Cecily's sugar and cake revenge erupts into open accusation of distrust and deceit.
Jack enters and Gwendolen greets him as Ernest.

pd_earnest_6.summary: Jack presents Algy as his brother; Gwendolen asks what his real Christian name is.
Jack quizzes Lady Bracknell and consults the Army Lists for his father's name.
He finds his name is Ernest after all, and Gwendolen forgives him.
Couples embrace, and Jack declares the importance of being earnest.

s01114.summary: Exhausted Dr. Anselmo ignores a page, sitting on the stairs.
He lists his workload and recalls advice about carrying what you cannot fix.
He straightens his paper hat, answers the call, and climbs back up.

pd_dollhouse_1.summary: Nora tells Christine how she secretly scrimped, copied, and paid off her debt.
Nora delights in feeling free from care just as the bell rings.
Krogstad arrives; Nora coldly sends him to the study as Mrs Linde recognizes him.

pd_dollhouse_3.summary: Helmer reassures Nora and sends her to practice the Tarantella before shutting his door.
Alone, Nora whispers desperately for any way out as the bell rings.
Dr. Rank tells Nora he is dying and bars Helmer from his sickroom.
Nora asks for cheer; they joke grimly about his father's rich living.

s01029.summary: Darryl smiles manically in a bleak office while his inner voice mocks corporate speak.

s00019.summary: Four people walk the dark mushroom tunnel with flashlights; Magnus evades the inspector.
Zuzu spots caps that seem to move; the Stranger shows they shrink from light.
Zuzu finds half a boot; Magnus explains it away as a picker who quit.
The Stranger notes Magnus locked the gate; rustling nears and Magnus admits his keys open another door.
A cap rises; the Stranger draws a steel canister and leads them the other way.

s01113.summary: The crew finds cryo pod 17 cold and reportedly empty.
Odalys orders the capsule opened and finds a blanket, a child's drawing, and a dead monitor.
Santiago restrains Pixie, they seal the pod, and Miriam steadies Odalys as she pockets the drawing.

s01082.summary: Barnaby rehearses a pirate speech to an empty clubhouse while bored Odalys teases him.
A noisy family enters; Barnaby hams it up and Odalys deadpans back.
His hat rolls to a child, and they hand out putters with parting jabs.

s01050.summary: Widowed Odalys sits in a car wash, narrating her husband never washing the car.
She laughs, stops, and drives out into the light.

pd_earnest_2.summary: Cecily and Miss Prism chat about German, Uncle Jack's seriousness, diaries and novels.
Chasuble arrives; Cecily feigns Miss Prism's headache to prompt a stroll.
Miss Prism accepts the stroll and leaves Cecily to her studies.

s01070.summary: Soldiers in a flooded mill challenge a stranger who claims to live there.
Engines approach; Okafor kills the lantern and Halvorsen cocks his rifle.

s01110.summary: Cornelius leaves an answering-machine message telling estranged Mara her mother is dying.
He asks her to sing as she once did, then waits in static.

s01069.summary: A man and Nina prepare to crush a sedan at a salvage yard.
A kid named Eli refuses the crusher without papers, stonewalling their pressure.
The man grabs Eli; a brawl ends with Eli running the crusher on the sedan and the bag.
Eli cites Terrence's rules calmly as banknotes swirl from the crushed car.

pd_sisters_6.summary: Departing family members gather their things and bid the old life farewell.
Left alone, Lubov and Gaev sob in each other's arms and say good-bye to the orchard.
Locked in and forgotten, ill Fiers lies down as a breaking string and an axe sound.

s01092.summary: Coach Hester and her last rower Pascal share terse routine in the misty boathouse.
Hester pours tea for him; he softens and takes the mug.
They recall the full squad, and he worries about missing the cut; she says they row anyway.
Together they lift a shell and carry it out into the mist.

s01049.summary: Gloria calls another vote; Min-Jun wavers and Deez stays silent.
Deez erupts that the jury ignored the young defendant and Gloria decided on day one.
Gloria slaps down her cards, Deez knocks them to the floor, and Min-Jun intervenes.
The generator fails and the tent goes dark.

s01059.summary: Petra grills foreman Ottoline about the timber survey as Reginald objects.
A clerk bursts in with an urgent filing; both lawyers grab for it.
Ottoline reads the folder and says the ridge was never theirs.

s01066.summary: Bernadette radios Rescue One and gets a garbled reply, learning help is two hours away.
The floe splits; the survivors leap into the raft and cut the line.
The stove sinks as Rescue One reports a clear lock and tells them to stay put.

pd_dollhouse_4.summary: Mrs Linde tells Nora to delay Torvald while she acts, then leaves.
Nora begs Helmer not to check the letter box, plays the Tarantella, and gets him to the piano.
Nora dances wildly with tambourine and shawl as Helmer plays and Rank watches.

s00003.summary: The Deepwater Miners trail in the final; Abebe's stone dies short of the button.
Foreman Gus says the lane must clear for shift change but grants one last stone.
Inez gently coaches shaking Abebe; his clean release goes long and touches nothing.
